SMTO-SKL-0062 — SMTO can't find the file you want to send to Microsoft 365

GUID: 5c75e620-200a-59f6-8314-7552d0282232
Slug: microsoft365-artifact-reference-invalid
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: microsoft365

What happened

  • SMTO can only upload or attach files that belong to this conversation. The file it was given was a path on a computer, belonged to another conversation, or no longer exists, so nothing was sent.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Select Add files to conversation in the message box and add the file you want to send. Adding it makes the file part of this conversation, which is the only place SMTO takes files from.
  2. Or use a file SMTO made earlier in this same conversation; you can find it under Artifacts. Files created in this conversation can be sent, but files from other conversations can't.
  3. Ask again and name the file exactly, for example "attach report.pdf that I just added". Naming the added file helps SMTO pick that copy instead of a path on your computer.

What success looks like

  • SMTO confirms the upload or attachment, and the file appears in OneDrive or on the email draft.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A Microsoft 365 upload or attachment source_ref is not a supported artifact:// or artifact-workspace:// reference, or the artifact cannot be opened for the current conversation.

What this means

  • Upload source_ref does not use a supported artifact or artifact-workspace reference form. This explanation performs no Microsoft request. The original operation stage and receipt determine its effect; keep the selected tenant, account and resource identity fixed during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • Upload source_ref does not use a supported artifact or artifact-workspace reference form.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the reference scheme and ownership instead of substituting an arbitrary host path.

How to fix it

  • Supply a source_ref that is an artifact:// URI, an art_ artifact ID or an artifact-workspace:// path and that resolves through ArtifactStore.open_stream for the current conversation_id; arbitrary filesystem paths and artifacts owned by other conversations are rejected. Register the file as a conversation artifact first.
  • Register the source as a conversation-owned artifact and supply artifact:// or artifact-workspace://; arbitrary filesystem paths are not accepted.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect provider state and exact account authority first.

How to verify the fix

  • An eligible conversation-owned source reference resolves before upload.

What not to do

  • Do not expose secrets or blindly replay uncertain mutations.

Technical notes

  • This explanation performs no Microsoft request. The original operation stage and receipt determine its effect; keep the selected tenant, account and resource identity fixed during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
